title: 子数组中占绝大多数的元素
summary: 设计 MajorityChecker，多次查询区间内出现次数至少为 threshold 的元素，不存在则返回负一；每次查询保证阈值超过区间长度一半。
insight: 线段树按 Boyer-Moore 规则合并区间候选值，可在对数时间得到唯一可能过半的候选；再在该值的有序位置列表中二分统计真实次数，避免把候选误当答案。
pitfalls: 多数投票只产生候选，必须再次验证频次
合并相同候选时票数相加，不同时互相抵消
位置计数区间左右端点都包含

solutions.title: 线段树候选与位置索引
solutions.idea: 对数时间提取区间候选并用二分确认出现次数。
steps: 构造线段树，每个节点保存该段多数投票后的 candidate 与 balance；同时记录每个值出现位置的升序列表
查询区间时按同候选相加、异候选抵消合并覆盖节点，得到唯一可能答案
在候选的位置列表中用 lower_bound(left) 与 upper_bound(right) 求次数；达到 threshold 返回候选，否则返回 -1

complexity.time: 构造 O(n log n)，查询 O(log n)

code.java: class MajorityChecker { private final int n;private final int[] candidate,balance;private final Map<Integer,List<Integer>> positions=new HashMap<>();public MajorityChecker(int[] arr){n=arr.length;candidate=new int[4*n];balance=new int[4*n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)positions.computeIfAbsent(arr[i],key->new ArrayList<>()).add(i);build(1,0,n-1,arr);}private void build(int node,int left,int right,int[] arr){if(left==right){candidate[node]=arr[left];balance[node]=1;return;}int middle=(left+right)/2;build(node*2,left,middle,arr);build(node*2+1,middle+1,right,arr);int[] merged=merge(candidate[node*2],balance[node*2],candidate[node*2+1],balance[node*2+1]);candidate[node]=merged[0];balance[node]=merged[1];}private int[] merge(int a,int aCount,int b,int bCount){if(a==b)return new int[]{a,aCount+bCount};return aCount>=bCount?new int[]{a,aCount-bCount}:new int[]{b,bCount-aCount};}private int[] rangeCandidate(int node,int left,int right,int queryLeft,int queryRight){if(queryLeft<=left&&right<=queryRight)return new int[]{candidate[node],balance[node]};int middle=(left+right)/2;if(queryRight<=middle)return rangeCandidate(node*2,left,middle,queryLeft,queryRight);if(queryLeft>middle)return rangeCandidate(node*2+1,middle+1,right,queryLeft,queryRight);int[] a=rangeCandidate(node*2,left,middle,queryLeft,queryRight),b=rangeCandidate(node*2+1,middle+1,right,queryLeft,queryRight);return merge(a[0],a[1],b[0],b[1]);}private int lowerBound(List<Integer> list,int target){int left=0,right=list.size();while(left<right){int middle=(left+right)/2;if(list.get(middle)<target)left=middle+1;else right=middle;}return left;}public int query(int left,int right,int threshold){int value=rangeCandidate(1,0,n-1,left,right)[0];List<Integer> list=positions.get(value);int count=lowerBound(list,right+1)-lowerBound(list,left);return count>=threshold?value:-1;} }
code.kotlin: class MajorityChecker(arr:IntArray) { private val n=arr.size;private val candidate=IntArray(4*n);private val balance=IntArray(4*n);private val positions=mutableMapOf<Int,MutableList<Int>>();init{for(i in arr.indices)positions.getOrPut(arr[i]){mutableListOf()}.add(i);build(1,0,n-1,arr)};private fun build(node:Int,left:Int,right:Int,arr:IntArray){if(left==right){candidate[node]=arr[left];balance[node]=1;return};val middle=(left+right)/2;build(node*2,left,middle,arr);build(node*2+1,middle+1,right,arr);val merged=merge(candidate[node*2],balance[node*2],candidate[node*2+1],balance[node*2+1]);candidate[node]=merged[0];balance[node]=merged[1]};private fun merge(a:Int,aCount:Int,b:Int,bCount:Int):IntArray=if(a==b)intArrayOf(a,aCount+bCount) else if(aCount>=bCount)intArrayOf(a,aCount-bCount) else intArrayOf(b,bCount-aCount);private fun rangeCandidate(node:Int,left:Int,right:Int,queryLeft:Int,queryRight:Int):IntArray{if(queryLeft<=left&&right<=queryRight)return intArrayOf(candidate[node],balance[node]);val middle=(left+right)/2;if(queryRight<=middle)return rangeCandidate(node*2,left,middle,queryLeft,queryRight);if(queryLeft>middle)return rangeCandidate(node*2+1,middle+1,right,queryLeft,queryRight);val a=rangeCandidate(node*2,left,middle,queryLeft,queryRight);val b=rangeCandidate(node*2+1,middle+1,right,queryLeft,queryRight);return merge(a[0],a[1],b[0],b[1])};private fun lowerBound(list:List<Int>,target:Int):Int{var left=0;var right=list.size;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;if(list[middle]<target)left=middle+1 else right=middle};return left};fun query(left:Int,right:Int,threshold:Int):Int{val value=rangeCandidate(1,0,n-1,left,right)[0];val list=positions[value]!!;val count=lowerBound(list,right+1)-lowerBound(list,left);return if(count>=threshold)value else -1} }
code.cpp: class MajorityChecker { int n;vector<int> candidate,balance;unordered_map<int,vector<int>> positions;pair<int,int> mergePair(int a,int aCount,int b,int bCount){if(a==b)return {a,aCount+bCount};return aCount>=bCount?make_pair(a,aCount-bCount):make_pair(b,bCount-aCount);}void build(int node,int left,int right,vector<int>& arr){if(left==right){candidate[node]=arr[left];balance[node]=1;return;}int middle=(left+right)/2;build(node*2,left,middle,arr);build(node*2+1,middle+1,right,arr);tie(candidate[node],balance[node])=mergePair(candidate[node*2],balance[node*2],candidate[node*2+1],balance[node*2+1]);}pair<int,int> rangeCandidate(int node,int left,int right,int queryLeft,int queryRight){if(queryLeft<=left&&right<=queryRight)return {candidate[node],balance[node]};int middle=(left+right)/2;if(queryRight<=middle)return rangeCandidate(node*2,left,middle,queryLeft,queryRight);if(queryLeft>middle)return rangeCandidate(node*2+1,middle+1,right,queryLeft,queryRight);auto a=rangeCandidate(node*2,left,middle,queryLeft,queryRight),b=rangeCandidate(node*2+1,middle+1,right,queryLeft,queryRight);return mergePair(a.first,a.second,b.first,b.second);}public:MajorityChecker(vector<int>& arr):n(arr.size()),candidate(4*n),balance(4*n){for(int i=0;i<n;++i)positions[arr[i]].push_back(i);build(1,0,n-1,arr);}int query(int left,int right,int threshold){int value=rangeCandidate(1,0,n-1,left,right).first;auto& list=positions[value];int count=upper_bound(list.begin(),list.end(),right)-lower_bound(list.begin(),list.end(),left);return count>=threshold?value:-1;} };
